method: Independent native PDF table extraction and rendered-page review. Physical group labels are assigned by the most recent bold, source-visible one-cell category row before each price-bearing row; known heading labels are finite and grounded in the PDF print. No parser category output is used to assign physical headings. Every existing or newly recovered observation maps to exactly one source page/table/row/round.

limits: The scope is the exact seven PDF members in the retained 2021-11-16 ZIP, with 675 current price observation rows. It is not a claim about all DANE city reports.
Literal source-heading spelling and accents are preserved, including the typo `Verduras y hortailizas`.

Source category proof relies on the seven-column table row order, exact bold heading rows and rendered source pages. Generalizing the aliases beyond these source identities is not justified by this packet.

This packet identifies prior category-label mismatches; it does not by itself authorize updates to immutable regional_price or regional_classification rows. Existing category overlay proofs are required for the 140 already-published rows.

physical_category_header_derivation.category_value: Literal visible top-level group header text, retained without spell correction; e.g. source typo `Verduras y hortailizas` stays literal.
